title: The runway into the bay
subtitle: A mapped peninsula, with the surviving seawall evidence highlighted
idea: Understand the airport's unusual relationship to the water.
limit: Only partial runway edges and the August 1993 southeastern seawall are traced. Shoreline completion, water height and exact threshold registration remain unresolved.
caption: The map records the runway projecting into Kowloon Bay. Highlighted linework is the actually digitized evidence, not a completed shoreline. Published landing distance available is 2,786 m; it is not the runway's total physical length.
